sources.title: HYG Database trimmed star catalogues
sources.transformation: scripts/trim_bright_stars.py filters the full HYG catalogue into magnitude tiers and keeps only ra, dec, mag, pmra, pmdec, ci, spect, and proper columns used by SSAPy Toolkit renderers.
sources.notes: The original full catalogue is not redistributed in this package. The preprocessing script verifies retained rows and columns against the local source file when run with --verify.

sources.title: SSAPy Toolkit 2048x1024 Earth viewer texture layers
sources.source_title: matteason/live-cloud-maps Earth, night, specular, and cloud texture products
sources.license: CC0 1.0 Universal for repository code/images, with EUMETSAT attribution required for cloud data and NASA public-domain base imagery
additional_attribution: NASA Earth imagery / Blue Marble base imagery
sources.transformation: scripts/unpack_viewer_textures.py split a legacy SSAPy Toolkit satellite_viewer_textures.npz archive into individual image files with one manifest checksum per texture.
sources.notes: The exact upstream image timestamp from the original texture archive was not recorded. Do not replace or add Earth texture layers without recording the upstream URL, retrieval time, license, and checksum.

sources.title: Earth surface classification raster for solar-body rendering
sources.source_title: NASA Visible Earth Blue Marble imagery
sources.transformation: Compressed NumPy archive containing a 512x1024 uint8 surface-classification raster used by SSAPy Toolkit plotting code.
sources.notes: The generating script and exact source mosaic checksum were not present in this repository when the citation ledger was added. Keep this entry as legacy provenance until the classification can be regenerated from a recorded NASA source image.

sources.title: Propulsion data source ledger
sources.notes: Propulsion source records, including NASA NTRS table transcriptions, digitized NTRS thrust curves, and ThrustCurve.org public-domain imports, are maintained in propulsion/sources.json.

sources.title: IERS Finals2000A Earth orientation snapshot
sources.source_title: International Earth Rotation and Reference Systems Service (IERS) Bulletin A
sources.distribution: IERS public scientific distribution; attribution required
sources.license: No SPDX license asserted by the source endpoint
sources.transformation: The original fixed-width 187-byte source file is frozen without numeric transformation; the JSON sidecar records the checksum, field units, byte ranges, and snapshot metadata.
sources.notes: Historical, rapid-service, predicted, and date-only records are retained. Consumers must preserve the I/P status and explicitly opt in to predicted values.

sources.title: CelesTrak Space Weather daily solar and geomagnetic indices
sources.distribution: CelesTrak public space-weather distribution; attribution required
sources.license: No SPDX license asserted by the source endpoint
sources.transformation: The original CSV is frozen without numeric transformation; the JSON sidecar records the checksum and fields used by SSATK.
sources.notes: Observed, interpolated, predicted daily, and predicted monthly records are retained. The NRLMSISE-00 adapter rejects predicted records unless explicitly enabled.
